newsitem.title: CANADA: Intrawest said in big Colorado acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Intrawest said in big Colorado acquisition.

text.p: IntraWest Corp said it plans to make a "major" announcement Tuesday and analysts expected the resort developer to disclose plans to acquire a Colorado ski operation, possibly Copper Mountain.
An Intrawest spokeswoman would only say that the company would announce a development of major importance to the North American ski industry.

Analysts said they expected the news to concern a big acquisition in Colorado. "Copper Mountain is what I've been hearing," said one analyst who asked not to be identified. Intrawest shares were halted on the Toronto exchange.
